name: QR digital menu
title: QR Code Digital Menu for Restaurants in Nepal · FeastoX
description: Replace paper menus with a QR code digital menu. Update prices and availability instantly, show dish photos and ratings, no app for diners to install.
h1: A QR code digital menu your diners will actually use
intro: Put a QR code on every table. Diners scan it, and your full menu opens in their phone browser with photos, prices and real ratings. No app to install, no account to create.

sections.h: Change the menu in seconds, not reprints
sections.p: Edit dishes, prices and categories from the dashboard and the menu updates everywhere at once. Mark a dish unavailable the moment the kitchen runs out, so nobody orders what you cannot serve.
Every dish shows its photo, description and a verified rating with the number of diners behind it. Instead of guessing, guests can see what other people who ate it actually thought.

Each table gets its own QR code, so an order always arrives tagged with the right table. The code carries no prices or personal data, so a printed code never goes out of date when you change the menu.
Prices are shown in Rs., and the menu works on any phone with a browser, including mid-range Android devices on a mobile connection.

faqs.q: Do diners need to download an app to see the QR menu?
faqs.a: No. The menu opens in the phone's normal browser after scanning the QR code.

faqs.q: Can I update my digital menu after printing the QR codes?
faqs.a: Yes. The QR code only points to your restaurant and table. Menu and price changes appear immediately without reprinting.

name: QR table ordering
title: QR Table Ordering for Restaurants and Cafes · FeastoX
description: Let diners order from their table by scanning a QR code. Orders reach your kitchen queue by table, with live status from accepted to ready.
h1: QR table ordering that sends clean orders to your kitchen
intro: Diners scan, pick their dishes and place the order from their seat. Your staff see it in a live queue, tagged with the table, and move it through the kitchen.

sections.p: Orders are typed by the diner, not taken from memory. Staff see exactly what was ordered, with add-ons and notes, so the kitchen works from the real ticket.

sections.h: A live order queue for staff
sections.p: Every order moves one step at a time: accepted, preparing, ready, completed. Staff can mark a dish unavailable, and the diner sees the status update on their phone.
A table can place more than one order during a visit. They stay grouped under the same dining session, so the bill and history stay together.
Totals, tax and service charge are always calculated on the server from your own menu and settings, so a diner's phone can never change what an order costs.

faqs.q: Does the diner have to create an account to order?
faqs.a: No. Ordering works anonymously from the table's QR code.

faqs.q: What happens if the diner taps the order button twice?
faqs.a: The order is idempotent, so a retried submission returns the original order instead of creating a duplicate.

name: Dish ratings
title: Verified Dish Ratings and Reviews for Restaurants · FeastoX
description: Collect purchase-verified ratings on every dish: taste, portion and value. See which dishes diners love and which ones to fix or remove.
h1: Dish-level ratings that only real diners can leave
intro: Restaurant reviews tell you about the evening. FeastoX tells you about each dish. Only someone who ordered and received a dish can rate it, so the feedback is honest and specific.

sections.p: Diners give an overall score and rate taste, portion size and value for money. They also say whether they would order the dish again and can leave a short comment.
A rating is tied to a completed order that contained the dish, with one review per dish per order. Ratings are always shown with how many diners left them.
A dish with a perfect score from two people does not outrank one rated slightly lower by hundreds. Rankings are adjusted for how many ratings a dish has, so the top of your menu is trustworthy.

sections.h: Know what to keep, fix or drop
sections.p: The dashboard shows which dishes are loved, which are reordered and which are quietly disappointing, so menu decisions come from data, not guesses.

faqs.q: Can a restaurant fake or delete bad dish ratings?
faqs.a: Ratings come only from verified orders and are not created by the restaurant.

faqs.q: How do diners leave a rating?
faqs.a: After an order is completed, the diner is prompted to rate the dishes they ate, straight from the order page.

name: For cafes
title: QR Menu and Ordering Software for Cafes · FeastoX
description: A QR menu and table ordering system for cafes: quick ordering, easy price updates, add-ons and dish ratings. Start with a free trial.
h1: QR menu and ordering for busy cafes
intro: Cafes turn tables fast and run on small teams. FeastoX lets guests order from the table while your staff stay focused on the counter and the kitchen.

sections.p: Regulars scan, order and sit back. Your team sees one clean queue instead of shouting orders across the room.
Extra shots, milk choices, sides and toppings are set up once as add-ons and offered on the dishes where they apply.
Rotate specials, hide sold-out items and change prices from your phone or laptop, and the menu is current at every table.
Ratings show which drinks and bakes diners love, so you can put them first and retire what does not sell.

faqs.q: Is FeastoX suitable for a small cafe with a few tables?
faqs.a: Yes. The same menu, ordering and rating flow works for six tables or six branches.

name: For restaurants
title: QR Menu and Table Ordering for Restaurants · FeastoX
description: Digital menu, QR table ordering, staff roles and dish analytics for restaurants. Know which dishes to promote, fix or remove.
h1: A digital menu and ordering system that shows what is worth ordering
intro: FeastoX combines a QR menu, table ordering and verified dish ratings in one system, with roles for staff, managers and owners.

sections.h: The right access for each person
sections.p: Staff work the order queue. Managers edit the menu, tables and QR codes. Owners also control tax, service charge and settings.
Create tables, print a unique QR code for each one and organise them by floor so orders always arrive with the right location.
See best-selling and best-rated dishes, how often a dish is reordered, and which dishes are ordered together.
Create your account, add your menu and print your table codes in a few minutes. New restaurants begin on a free trial before choosing a monthly or yearly plan.

faqs.q: Can different staff have different permissions?
faqs.a: Yes. Staff, manager and owner roles each see and change only what they need to.
Create an account on the Get started page, add your menu, then print a QR code for each table.
